news.title: Indian tech tycoon bets $30M of his own money to build AI alternative to Microsoft Office
news.description: Neo is Bhavin Turakhia’s fifth venture and his latest involving enterprise software. This time he's taking on Microsoft Office, Google Apps with AI.

news.title: SpaceX has an AI device prototype, and it sure sounds phone-ish
news.description: SpaceX reportedly showed investors a "handset-like" AI device before going public. It could be another signal SpaceX wants to expand into wireless.

news.title: Cloudflare’s new policy pushes AI companies to pay for publishers’ content
news.description: Cloudflare is giving AI companies until September 15 to separate web crawlers used for search from those used for AI training and agents, or risk being blocked by default on many publisher sites.

news.title: Venice AI becomes a unicorn with $65M Series A as its privacy-first AI platform takes off
news.description: Venice AI is already profitable, with annualized run-rate revenues of over $70 million, CEO Erik Voorhees said.

news.title: Wonka Netflix show faces backlash for AI-generated Gene Wilder voice
news.description: The actor, who died in 2016, appears in the Netflix show with the consent of his estate.

news.title: You Can Now Sound the Alarm on AI Behaving Badly
news.description: Are you worried your AI chatbot is trying to build a bomb or leak personal information about you? There’s a website for that.

news.title: New attack provides one more reason why AI browsers are a bad idea
news.description: Telling an LLM that 2 + 2 = 5 is enough to make it follow forbidden instructions.

news.title: Notion killing Skiff-influenced email app since most users use AI agents instead
news.description: Notion is "going all in on using agents to run your inbox."
